"No editorialized titles" is a rule I've seen go overboard on Reddit and used as a tool for censorship instead of enforcing clarity. I usually support "no clickbait" as a rule, as long as "clickbait" is clearly defined, usually meaning a title that doesn't accurately reflect the content submitted. It's one thing to use your own language in a post's title, but it's another thing when a reader can't accurately predict what the content is from the title's description.

Phaedrus had spent years examining the Crystal of Reflection.

This isn't strictly true, in reality he only spent the better part of a week, the agonizing slow return journey back to the encampment was worsened considerably by the slowness at which the world moved. With nothing else to do, he studied. Such was the mark of the Order of Moonlight. The endless curiosity, the endless search. What he learned from the crystal he stored within its infinite depths. Day and night, every hour of every cycle, spent exhaustively searching and understanding the crystal.

As he continued to learn, time seemed to slow even more, he pushed the limits of the crystal's limitations, until time slowed to the barest sign of a crawl. Every moment was an eternity, all of eternity was a moment.

So when Phaedrus returned to the southern encampment, the crystal was packed with knowledge of itself. Phaedrus could only hope it would be enough for what was intended.

*****

Some time had passed, the envoys to the other races would soon be arriving at their destinations. The critical moment was arriving, it was nearly time to act.

Luminus hovered amongst the treetops, taking in even more light, draining energy from the Gaean landscape. This has become a daily ritual of late, for the task he had in mind, much energy must be expended, and may be continuously expended.

When Phaedrus returned, they will have much to share. His ingenuity and curiosity was highly intriguing. Perhaps he could continue from the work Luminus had started with the invention of moonfire, just as Luminus planned to continue the work Phaedrus had done with the Crystal he undoubtedly carried.

***** *****

Phaedrus arrived at the settlement, it was smaller than it was before, some buildings have collapsed due to the earthquakes, but they still served their purpose. Comfort was never the issue, most shelters were barely more than overhangs, keeping out the moonlight. He continued to focus on his work, there was a little that he still did not understand about the crystal.

He was deep in thought when Luminus arrived to greet the returning team. He cared not for the words of congratulations and the acknowledgement of their service. He knew Luminus would notice, he knew Luminus would understand. The work here was much too important to be disrupted.

Finally, after what seemed like months, the others were released from the clearing.

"I think that is quite enough." A concentrated thought, delivered in a single packet arrived at the fringes of his mind.

"Our work is not quite complete. Not yet." Phaedrus replied.

"No, it isn't, but the sacrifice needed to finish it is not yours to make. I chose this path, you gave me the opportunity, besides, there is other work for you to do."

"Do you mean the new energy that permeates Gaea?"

"Yes, inside my study is a crystal fragment, it contains the knowledge I have compiled about the new energy, as well as my experiments with moonfire. You can continue my work where I left off, and I will continue yours. That was the way it must be, you have always known it."

With a heavy heart, Phaedrus placed the new information he gathered into the crystal, and offered it to Luminus.

With agonizing slowness, Luminus took the crystal, and gazed into its depths. He nodded, and with his silence, communicated his gratitude.

Phaedrus turned away, there was always something new to learn, something new to discover. This new 'magic' would be a good place to start.

Phaedrus returns to the Southern Forest with the Crystal of Reflection, which currently stores a vast amount of information about the Crystal of Reflection. Luminus then demands and receives the Crystal of Reflection, while tasking Phaedrus with experimenting with the new energy permeating Gaea and the nature of moonfire.
